company.name: FOM Group
company.description:
FOM Group is building an integrated ecosystem of IT products tailored for the pharmaceutical markets in Uzbekistan and the UAE, connecting key industry stakeholders through data-driven and user-centric solutions.

Products:

F-Pharmacy – A comprehensive software solution for pharmacies and pharmacy chains that automates end-to-end operations, from inventory and shelf management to point-of-sale processes.

F-Summary – A B2B marketplace connecting pharmacies with distributors, enabling seamless ordering of medicines from a network of over 200 suppliers in just a few clicks.

ArzonApteka – A consumer-focused (B2C) platform that helps users easily find medicines nearby at the best available prices across the country.

DATFO – A Big Data analytics platform designed for distributors and manufacturers, offering actionable insights through reports and demand forecasts based on purchases, sales, and search trends in the pharmaceutical market.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,000,000, or 85.71% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $11,000,000 to $25,000,000, a 2.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
